entities.title: Engine strengths
entities.summary: Eight strengths, from Skill Level 0 to full strength; out-of-range levels are clamped.
criteria: Strength 1 sends Skill Level 0, the start position and go depth 1
Strength 8 sends the moves played and go movetime 2000
A strength above 8 is treated as 8

checks.symbol: engine strengths: eight levels, from skill 0 to full strength

checks.description: Play the computer in a browser at a low and a high strength; Take back and leave the screen during a search, and check no stale move is played.

entities.details: Only commandsFor is tested; the Web Worker, the pauses and cancelling are not, since node has no Worker for Stockfish here.
